gen-gf-funnel-display-gf-noto-serif-guja: Noto Serif Gujarati reads like a classic serif, bookish and sure of itself, with generous counters and strokes that only gently thicken and thin. Funnel Display sits over it, one uniform line with no hairlines at all.
gen-gf-funnel-display-gf-noto-serif-gurm: Noto Serif Gurmukhi gives you a generous x-height and a weight change that glides rather than snaps. Noto Serif Gurmukhi against Funnel Display's level, accent-free strokes makes the pair's strongest quality a steady, literary hush.
gen-gf-funnel-display-gf-noto-serif-hebr: Stone-cut and sturdy, Noto Serif Hebrew carries a tall body and a slight heft shift, while Funnel Display draws everything in one steady line. Funnel Display is the loud one; the carved texture belongs to its partner.
gen-gf-funnel-display-gf-noto-serif-kann: Funnel Display draws every stem and diagonal with the same heft, giving it a rope-like, commanding presence. And Noto Serif Kannada, a serif with big counters and a modest stem-to-hairline ratio, does the quieter, literary work of carrying text.
gen-gf-funnel-display-gf-noto-serif-khme: Noto Serif Khmer reads authoritative, its lowercase standing nearly level with the capitals. Hairlines stay fairly sturdy beside the stems, so if Funnel Display is shrunk small, it loses the commanding spaghetti-line presence that makes it work.
gen-gf-funnel-display-gf-noto-serif-lao: Big, bookish, unhurried: that is the look here. Funnel Display does its best work drawing hairline-free monoline shapes with command, while Noto Serif Lao does its best with a tall lowercase and gentle stress in the curves.
gen-gf-funnel-display-gf-noto-serif-maka: Dignified, with a towering x-height like a carpenter's pencil stroke. Noto Serif Makasar keeps its weights close, so reading runs smoothly under Funnel Display's toothpaste-steady, one-line heading without any jolt between thick and thin.
gen-gf-funnel-display-gf-noto-serif-mala: Noto Serif Malayalam brings big open counters and bowls that thin gracefully, never sharply, under a heading drawn as true monoline. Funnel Display's uniform strokes against that understated contrast are the pair's strongest quality.
gen-gf-funnel-display-gf-noto-serif-np-h: Refined and literary, Noto Serif NP Hmong carries a faint pressure shadow like worn charcoal, with horizontals slightly slimmer than verticals. And Funnel Display, its stroke holding one width throughout, makes the pair's strongest quality a clean split between commanding and gentle.
gen-gf-funnel-display-gf-noto-serif-old-: Funnel Display runs a rope-like consistency through every stem, bowl and tail, bold and expressive in a way few faces manage. Noto Serif Old Uyghur takes the quieter job, with tall glassy bowls and a middle-path text serif contrast.
